name: Systems landscape and data flow map
summary: Before a major system decision, or at the annual review, the operations or systems lead gets one map of the company's systems from the lists and interviews supplied: what each is the record for, who owns it, which data moves between them, and every gap and duplicate record of truth as a question.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of this work, from which the systems table, the rules that name a record of truth only where an owner or a note states it, the flow list and plain-text diagram, the marking of gaps and duplicate records of truth, and the questions addressed to the people who can answer them were written for this template.
